name: Leaderboard
description: Shows one of your game's boards — point it at the game.state key your game writes the rows to. Works with: Game Flow.

drivenBy.rule: This panel only paints what it reads — the server writes the rows into the synced state key named in Board Key, and every client draws them in order.
drivenBy.next: Press New script below and write that line inside the isServer() block it comes with, using the same key you set in Board Key above.

changelog.notes: Initial release: a panel that reads the game.state key you name in boardKey and paints its top rows, so the board a Script keeps is the board every player sees and a late joiner gets it from the snapshot.
The placed panel's Script card now shows the setState line that writes the rows it paints, under its own settings.
